# `mise tasks log`

- **Usage:** `mise tasks log [--path] <TASK>`
- **Effect:** read-only
- **Source code:** [`src/cli/tasks/log.rs`](https://github.com/jdx/mise/blob/main/src/cli/tasks/log.rs)

Print the output of a task's last run

mise keeps the combined stdout and stderr of each task's most recent run, after redaction, so output that `replacing`, `timed`, `silent` or a truncated terminal hid can be read without running the task again. Each run replaces the task's previous log, and a log keeps at most its last 4 MiB.

mise only logs output it reads: a `raw` or `interactive` task, or an `interleave` task without redactions (whose output goes straight to the terminal), has no log.

## Arguments
- **`<TASK>`** — Name of the task

## Flags
- **`--path`** — Print the path of the log file instead of its contents

  The path is printed even when the task has no log yet.
- **`-h --help`** — Print help

## Examples

Print the output of the last run of the test task

```
mise tasks log test
```

Print where that log is kept

```
mise tasks log test --path
```
